phases.name: Build the Balance Sheet
phases.summary: Establish foundational capital products that generate yield from real-world assets and create the core balance sheet for the Axiom ecosystem.

products.name: Axiom High Yield Savings
products.tagline: Earn competitive yields backed by real estate cash flows
products.strategicValue: Creates the first on-ramp for capital into the Axiom ecosystem. Establishes trust through transparent, yield-generating accounts backed by real assets.
products.targetUsers: Retail investors, crypto-native savers, community members seeking stable yields
products.revenueModel: Spread between lending rates and deposit yields, management fees on AUM
products.legalNotes: Structured as participation in lending pool returns under SEC Reg D 506(c)
products.onchainModules: AXUSD VaultEngine, Yield Distribution Router, Balance Tracking SBT
products.offchainModules: KYC verification, investor onboarding, reporting portal

milestones.name: Smart Contract Development
milestones.description: Deploy savings vault contracts with yield distribution logic

milestones.name: Investor Portal Launch
milestones.description: Launch web interface for deposits, withdrawals, and yield tracking

products.name: Axiom Mortgage Notes
products.tagline: Fractional ownership in performing real estate loans
products.strategicValue: Enables community participation in private credit markets previously reserved for institutions. Diversifies protocol revenue through loan origination fees.
products.targetUsers: Accredited investors, family offices, crypto funds seeking real-world yield
products.revenueModel: Origination fees (1-2%), servicing fees (0.25-0.5% annually), spread on interest
products.legalNotes: SEC Reg D 506(c) compliant offering, accredited investor verification required
products.offchainModules: Loan origination system, borrower underwriting, payment servicing

milestones.name: Fix-and-Flip Pool Launch
milestones.description: Deploy first lending pool for bridge loans

milestones.name: DSCR Rental Loans
milestones.description: Expand to long-term rental property financing

products.name: Axiom Rent Streams
products.tagline: Tokenized rental income from real properties
products.strategicValue: Creates predictable cash flow streams that back AXUSD minting. Connects physical property performance to on-chain settlement.
products.targetUsers: Yield-focused investors, protocol treasury, liquidity providers
products.revenueModel: Property management fees, rent collection fees, protocol revenue share
products.legalNotes: Structured as revenue participation agreements with property SPVs
products.offchainModules: Property management integration, rent collection, tenant screening

milestones.name: Pilot Properties
milestones.description: Onboard first 5 rental properties to the platform

phases.name: Turn Capital Into Infrastructure
phases.summary: Deploy accumulated capital into land acquisition and community development projects that create long-term value and infrastructure.

products.name: Community Land Funds
products.tagline: Collective ownership of strategic land parcels
products.strategicValue: Enables community-scale land acquisition that individuals cannot achieve alone. Creates physical infrastructure for the Axiom ecosystem.
products.revenueModel: Land appreciation, development fees, lease income, token value accrual
products.legalNotes: SEC Reg CF compliant crowdfunding with tokenized land options
products.offchainModules: Property sourcing, due diligence, title verification, steward coordination

milestones.name: Land Acquisition Pipeline
milestones.description: Establish property sourcing and evaluation workflow

milestones.name: First Community Purchase
milestones.description: Complete first community-funded land acquisition

products.name: Builder and Farmer Credit
products.tagline: Working capital for land development and agriculture
products.strategicValue: Finances productive use of community land. Creates circular economy where development generates returns that fund more development.
products.revenueModel: Interest on working capital loans, equipment financing fees, harvest revenue share
products.legalNotes: Commercial lending under state regulations, collateralized by equipment and crops
products.offchainModules: Borrower underwriting, equipment appraisal, crop monitoring

milestones.name: Credit Framework Design
milestones.description: Define underwriting criteria and loan structures

phases.name: Turn Axiom Into a Financial State
phases.summary: Establish Axiom as a self-sustaining financial ecosystem with its own credit creation, insurance, and treasury management capabilities.

products.name: AXUSD Credit Lines
products.tagline: Borrow against your Axiom assets without selling
products.strategicValue: Enables community members to access liquidity without exiting positions. Creates demand for AXUSD and deepens ecosystem engagement.
products.targetUsers: AXM holders, property owners, protocol participants
products.revenueModel: Interest on credit lines, origination fees, liquidation penalties
products.legalNotes: Collateralized lending with automated liquidation, no securities involved
products.offchainModules: Credit scoring integration, notification system, position monitoring

milestones.name: Collateral Framework
milestones.description: Define acceptable collateral types and LTV ratios

milestones.name: Investor Portal Launch
milestones.description: Launch web interface for borrowing, repayment, and position tracking

products.name: Insurance Pools
products.strategicValue: Reduces systemic risk and increases confidence in protocol participation. Creates additional yield opportunities for capital providers.
products.targetUsers: Risk-averse participants, capital providers seeking premium income
products.revenueModel: Insurance premiums, investment returns on reserves, reinsurance fees
products.legalNotes: Structured as risk-sharing pool, not licensed insurance product
products.offchainModules: Claims assessment, actuarial modeling, reserve management

milestones.name: Risk Model Development
milestones.description: Build actuarial models for protocol risks

milestones.name: Coverage Portal Launch
milestones.description: Launch web interface for purchasing coverage and filing claims

products.name: Axiom Treasury Notes
products.tagline: Fixed-income instruments backed by protocol revenue
products.strategicValue: Creates institutional-grade fixed income product. Establishes Axiom as issuer of sovereign-like debt instruments.
products.revenueModel: Spread between note yields and treasury investment returns
products.legalNotes: SEC Reg D 506(c) offering, fixed maturity and coupon structure
products.offchainModules: Investor relations, quarterly reporting, rating agency liaison

milestones.name: Structure Design
milestones.description: Define note terms, maturities, and coupon structures

milestones.name: Investment Portal Launch
milestones.description: Launch web interface for note purchases and coupon tracking

phases.name: Arbitrum Infrastructure Evolution
phases.summary: Leverage Arbitrum's latest infrastructure upgrades including Stylus smart contracts, Orbit L3, gasless transactions, and institutional protocol integrations to enhance performance, reduce costs, and prepare for Universe Blockchain migration.

products.name: Stylus Smart Contracts
products.strategicValue: Migrate compute-intensive contracts to Stylus for major gas cost reduction. Enables complex operations like credit scoring and liquidations at lower cost while maintaining EVM interoperability.
products.targetUsers: All protocol users benefit from reduced transaction costs
products.revenueModel: Cost reduction increases protocol competitiveness and user retention
products.legalNotes: Technical upgrade, no regulatory changes required
products.offchainModules: Rust toolchain, Cargo Stylus CLI, Motsu testing framework

milestones.name: Development Environment Setup
milestones.description: Configure Rust toolchain, Stylus SDK, and testnet deployment pipeline

milestones.name: AxiomScoreSBT Migration
milestones.description: Port credit score calculation logic to Rust and deploy to testnet

milestones.name: Stylus Sprint Grant Application
milestones.description: Submit proposal for 5M ARB Stylus Sprint grant program

milestones.name: Production Deployment
milestones.description: Deploy audited Stylus contracts to Arbitrum One mainnet

products.name: RWA Infrastructure Integration
products.strategicValue: Position Axiom's real estate products within Arbitrum's institutional RWA ecosystem. Access STEP 2.0 grants and partnerships with BlackRock BUIDL, Franklin Templeton BENJI, and other institutional players.
products.targetUsers: Institutional investors, accredited investors, protocol treasury
products.revenueModel: Enhanced liquidity, institutional capital access, grant funding
products.legalNotes: Maintain SEC Reg D 506(c) compliance for institutional integrations
products.onchainModules: Cross-collateral adapters, BUIDL integration, treasury diversification

milestones.name: STEP 2.0 Grant Application
milestones.description: Submit proposal to ArbitrumDAO for RWA lending infrastructure funding

milestones.name: BlackRock BUIDL Assessment
milestones.description: Technical and legal assessment of BUIDL integration for treasury backing

milestones.name: Institutional Partner Onboarding
milestones.description: Establish relationships with 2+ institutional RWA protocols on Arbitrum

products.name: Timeboost MEV Protection
products.tagline: Fair transaction ordering for DEX and liquidations
products.strategicValue: Protect users from front-running and sandwich attacks on DEX trades and liquidations. Timeboost has generated $5M+ in protocol revenue on Arbitrum.
products.targetUsers: DEX traders, liquidation participants, all swap users
products.revenueModel: Reduced slippage improves user retention and trading volume
products.onchainModules: DEX V2 Router integration, Liquidator priority settings

milestones.name: Timeboost Integration
milestones.description: Enable Timeboost for DEX V2 and liquidation transactions

milestones.name: MEV Analytics Dashboard
milestones.description: Build monitoring dashboard for MEV protection effectiveness

products.name: Universe Blockchain L3
products.tagline: Axiom's sovereign Layer 3 on Arbitrum Orbit
products.strategicValue: Launch dedicated L3 with custom gas tokens (AXM/AXUSD), near-instant finality, and full ecosystem control. L3s settling to Arbitrum One are exempt from 10% revenue sharing.
products.revenueModel: Full sequencer revenue capture, custom tokenomics
products.legalNotes: Requires legal review of sovereign chain implications
products.onchainModules: Orbit deployment, custom precompiles, bridge contracts
products.offchainModules: RaaS partnership (Zeeve/Ankr), block explorer, L3 infrastructure

milestones.name: L3 Architecture Design
milestones.description: Define gas token, DA layer, block time, and custom precompiles

milestones.name: RaaS Partner Selection
milestones.description: Evaluate and select Zeeve, Ankr, or Alchemy for deployment support

milestones.name: Testnet Launch
milestones.description: Deploy Universe Blockchain testnet with full contract suite

milestones.name: Mainnet Migration
milestones.description: Production launch with liquidity incentives and user migration

products.name: ArbOS Dia Upgrade Adoption
products.tagline: Predictable fees and native account abstraction
products.strategicValue: Adopt ArbOS Dia features for better UX including predictable gas pricing, EIP-7702 account abstraction, and Ethereum Fusaka compatibility.
products.targetUsers: New users (gasless onboarding), all protocol participants
products.revenueModel: Improved onboarding increases user acquisition and retention
products.legalNotes: Technical upgrade, follows Arbitrum network timeline
products.onchainModules: Account abstraction wallets, fee prediction modules
products.offchainModules: Gasless transaction relayer, social recovery infrastructure

milestones.name: ArbOS Dia Compatibility
milestones.description: Test and update contracts for ArbOS Dia compatibility

milestones.name: Account Abstraction Wallets
milestones.description: Enable gasless transactions and social recovery for new users

products.name: 1inch Gasless Swaps
products.tagline: Trade without holding ETH for gas
products.strategicValue: Integrate 1inch gasless swap functionality allowing users to trade without ETH. Supports AXUSD-only ecosystem experience.
products.targetUsers: New users without ETH, AXUSD-native participants
products.revenueModel: Reduced friction increases swap volume and protocol fees
products.onchainModules: 1inch Fusion+ integration, DEX V2 gasless router
products.offchainModules: Gasless transaction signing, fee token configuration

milestones.name: 1inch API Integration
milestones.description: Integrate 1inch Fusion+ API for gasless swaps

milestones.name: AXUSD Gas Payment
milestones.description: Enable AXUSD as gas payment token for ecosystem transactions

products.name: Institutional Protocol Partnerships
products.tagline: Morpho, Euler, and Maple Finance integrations
products.strategicValue: Partner with leading institutional lending protocols on Arbitrum to create AXUSD lending markets, access institutional liquidity, and enable loan syndication.
products.targetUsers: Institutional investors, yield optimizers, large borrowers
products.revenueModel: Yield optimization fees, partnership revenue share
products.legalNotes: Each integration requires legal review of structure
products.onchainModules: Morpho market adapter, Euler vault integration, Maple pool participation

milestones.name: Morpho AXUSD Market
milestones.description: Deploy AXUSD lending market on Morpho with optimized risk parameters

milestones.description: Technical and risk assessment for Euler protocol integration
